gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrence of GBM (WHO grade IV) based on RANO criteria or GBM after subtotal resection of recurrence with macroscopic residual tumor;

candidate_evidence.quote: All patients will receive TTFields therapy and additionally Stereotactic Radiosurgery .

role_evidence.quote: All subjects will receive TTFields and radiosurgery plus/minus FET PET imaging to define tumor volume.

agents.drug_class_hint: [18F]FET amino-acid PET tracer (fluorine-18) for radiosurgery target definition
arms: TTFields and SRS based on MRI or FET-PET

source_quote.quote: Overall survival will be stratified by volume, PET-based treatment, SVZ invasion, MGMT methylation status, time to first progression, and TTFields compliance.

The attempt to obtain the Methyl-guanine methyl-transferase (MGMT) gene promoter methylation and IDH1 and IDH2 mutation from primary tumor are made during the study whenever not defined before entering to the study.

coder_notes: Device (TTFields) plus stereotactic radiosurgery only; no therapeutic drug, so S6 fails (no_pharmacological_candidate). [18F]FET PET tracer is not a registered intervention but is named in the title and arm label as part of SRS planning; listed as diagnostic_agent for transparency (could be omitted under R9). MGMT 'stratification' refers to post hoc survival analysis in a single-arm trial, not randomisation, so coded exploratory_correlative. Uses 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' and 'WHO grade IV', so historical.
